title: Be approved as a private adoption agency
what: Negotiate or arrange adoptions only as the director-general or a private adoption agency approved by the director-general; only charitable organisations can be approved.

sources.title: Adoption Act 1993 (ACT)
sources.quote: A person other than the director-general or a person acting on behalf of the director-general or a private adoption agency must not— (a) conduct negotiations or make arrangements with another person with a view to the adoption of a child or young person by that other person;

sources.title: Adoption Act 1993 (ACT)
sources.quote: the director-general must refuse the approval sought if it appears to the director-general that the applicant is— (a) not a charitable organisation;

sources.title: Adoption Act 1993 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 82(1), words naming the body (found 25 Nov 2026) (current republication (R26, effective 6 December 2025))
sources.quote: The director-general may grant or refuse to grant the approval sought in the application under section 81 (1).
